note: The content types this surface's artifacts take, beside the core's (image, swatch, render, brand-mark — sturij-core-editor src/assets/content-types.json). Declared here so the configurator's types — material, handle, room — exist as data before the Studio lands on the core (2dd904c6).

types.description: A text slot on the page — free text is content here, not a property; edited in place by an admin and versioned in site_content_slots.
A decor for doors or carcass — a registry product by code where one exists (Egger, sturij-assets), else the handoff's name with its misfit.
A handle finish — the handoff's procedural metals today; a Häfele product by code when the registry names a finish family.
A room finish (ceiling, walls, skirting, flooring) — the prototype's colour data until paints are registry records; and the room a visual renders into (bedroom, living room, kitchen, hallway).
The enquiry the form posts — the customer table's front door on sturij-web (mail-gate G5; form-surface §5.1); the visitor's swatch travels with it as data.
